inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "The Broken Wastes, a scorching desert of golden dunes where sand sharks hunt under the sand and the Clarth war hunters make their camp. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. A section of one wide connected region panorama, refined with crisp pixel clusters.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Hard bright noon sun from the upper left, short cool violet shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the salt flat arena in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#3d8fd6", "#8cc8ee", "#f2e2b8", "#e8b45a", "#d0903c", "#a8682c", "#efe6cf", "#c9b994", "#8a4a2c", "#c43a2e", "#c08a3a", "#4a3a5c", "#d8d4dc", "#b4aec0"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "A section of a continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera, no people: sky above a distant horizon, scenery behind the arena in overlapping rows, a calm empty floor.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 300, 1000], "desc": "a hot clear deep blue sky, paler and golden near the horizon, a white sun high at the upper left"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [540, 0, 1000, 1000], "desc": "one calm, empty, cracked pale salt flat running the whole width as the arena floor, cool pale grey with faint violet shadows, a worn trail along its back edge through all three places"}]}}
